name: Jarl Needs Eyes
summary: At Swamplight Manor, Jarl seeks forty unpopped Darkmist eyes for their smooth, salty juice. The spiders live in Darkmist Cavern, west of the manor.

sections.title: A Taste for Spider Eyes
sections.body: After Soothing Spices, Jarl turns to eye juice, a drink they enjoy. Most creatures have only two eyes, but spiders have many. Jarl likes the taste of Darkmist eye juice. The Darkmist spiders live in Darkmist Cavern, west of the manor. Jarl wonders whether the cave took its name from the spiders, or the spiders from the cave.

sections.title: A Feast for Jarl
sections.body: Jarl welcomes the eyes and calls them tasty. They say to save for last any eyes that stare back when stared at, since they can keep a person company in the swamp. Then Jarl greets the little eyes, tastes them, and says they are like gooey, salty chicken.

faq.q: Who asks for the spider eyes?
faq.answer: “Swamp Eye” Jarl asks for the eyes at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Why does Jarl want spider eyes?
aliases: what does jarl do with eyes
faq.answer: Jarl enjoys drinking eye juice and likes Darkmist eye juice for its smooth, salty taste. Most creatures have only two eyes, while spiders have many.
The Darkmist spiders live in Darkmist Cavern, west of Swamplight Manor.

faq.q: How many eyes does Jarl want?
faq.answer: Jarl wants forty unpopped Darkmist eyes.
